observations: Black motorcycle helmet with multiple stickers on the front and sides.
Stickers include 'REACTOR', 'PRO TAPER', 'FX Factory Flex', and 'MOTOCROSS'.
Interior features grey padded visor and a red adjustment knob.
The helmet shows some surface wear and minor scuffs on the stickers.
No brand logo or model number is visible on the exterior in the photos.

claims.evidence: Requires a video of the helmet being tested for heat transfer.
This is a subjective statement about the helmet's condition and value.

claims.claim: Bought new 6 months ago. Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The helmet may have hidden cracks or structural damage not visible from the front or sides.
risks.proof: A video showing the helmet being spun or a close-up of the underside.

risks.risk: The visor may be cracked or have poor sealing.
risks.proof: A video showing the visor being tested for flexibility and seal.

risks.risk: The interior padding may be worn or have odors.
risks.proof: A photo of the interior with the helmet lying flat.
risks.if_unproven: as having worn or dirty interior

risks.risk: The helmet may not fit the buyer's head.
risks.proof: A photo of the helmet worn on the buyer's head.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the interior of the helmet.
Photo of the underside of the helmet.
Video of the helmet being spun to check for cracks or damage.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
